name: Treasure Hunter: Metal Detector
summary:
Welcome to Treasure Hunter: Metal Detector, a controller-first VR treasure hunt set on a sunny tropical beach.

Sweep the sand with your detector, listen and feel as the signal grows stronger, pinpoint the target, then switch to your shovel and dig up what is hidden. Every find goes into your bag—sell it for money, invest in better equipment, and head back out with greater range and improved chances of rarer discoveries.

FEATURES
• A complete search, pinpoint, dig, collect, sell, and upgrade loop
• 40 uniq
